# SpaceWeb
> SpaceWeb is a web hosting and infrastructure provider offering shared hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, domains, SSL, and related services.

SpaceWeb provides hosting products, domain registration, server infrastructure, and customer account management for individuals and businesses.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://spaceweb.pro/): Main entry point for SpaceWeb hosting and infrastructure services.
- [Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting): Overview of shared hosting plans and features.
- [VPS](https://spaceweb.pro/vps): Virtual private server offerings and configuration options.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://spaceweb.pro/dedicated): Dedicated server products for higher-performance workloads.
- [Domains](https://spaceweb.pro/domains): Domain registration, transfer, and domain-related services.
- [SSL Certificates](https://spaceweb.pro/ssl): SSL certificate offerings for website security.

## Hosting Services
- [Shared Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting): Shared hosting plans for websites and small projects.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting/wordpress): Hosting tailored for WordPress-based websites.
- [Business Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting/business): Hosting plans intended for business and commercial sites.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting/reseller): Hosting packages for agencies and resellers.
- [Email Hosting](https://spaceweb.pro/hosting/email): Hosted email services for custom domains.

## Server Infrastructure
- [VPS](https://spaceweb.pro/vps): Virtual servers with scalable resources and administrative control.
- [Linux VPS](https://spaceweb.pro/vps/linux): Linux-based VPS configurations and deployment options.
- [Windows VPS](https://spaceweb.pro/vps/windows): Windows virtual servers for compatible workloads.
- [Dedicated Servers](https://spaceweb.pro/dedicated): Physical server rentals with dedicated resources.
- [Server Colocation](https://spaceweb.pro/colocation): Colocation services for customer-owned hardware.
- [Backup Services](https://spaceweb.pro/backup): Backup and data protection options for hosted systems.

## Domains and Security
- [Domains](https://spaceweb.pro/domains): Search, register, and manage domain names.
- [Domain Transfer](https://spaceweb.pro/domains/transfer): Transfer existing domains to SpaceWeb management.
- [WHOIS](https://spaceweb.pro/domains/whois): Domain lookup and registration information search.
- [SSL Certificates](https://spaceweb.pro/ssl): Certificate options for securing websites and services.
- [Wildcard SSL](https://spaceweb.pro/ssl/wildcard): SSL certificates covering subdomains under one domain.
- [Site Security](https://spaceweb.pro/security): Security-related services and protections for hosted projects.
